input: head is None or the first node of a finite, acyclic singly linked list of n distinct node objects, with 0 <= n <= 4294967295. Each caller-owned ListNode has ordinary writable data fields val and next; val is an integer in [-9007199254740991, 9007199254740991], and next is another node or None. No getters, proxies, custom assignment behavior or concurrent observers/mutations are allowed. External aliases may point at any input node and observe the final rewiring. Input value order is arbitrary, and duplicates are accepted. Integers are plain int values, excluding bool. Containers are ordinary lists rather than subclasses; strings are ordinary str values. Standard built-ins are unmodified and no concurrent mutation occurs. Preconditions are not checked at runtime. Declared size bounds do not guarantee allocation capacity or completion within an unqualified runtime budget.
return: The original nodes sorted by nondecreasing value, stably preserving their original identity order among equal values. Return the first original node or None for empty input. No copied output nodes or separate value array are created.
mutation_aliasing: Input node values and identities are preserved, but next fields are repeatedly cut and merged. Every original node appears exactly once in the final acyclic, None-terminated list. Caller aliases observe final next-edge changes; detached intermediate runs are internal and concurrent observers are excluded. Exactly one private Link sentinel is created per call and never returned. Helpers allocate no new nodes, pair records or recursion frames. The Solution instance retains no state.
numeric: Value comparisons use <= without arithmetic. Length is at most 4294967295; doubled run_size reaches at most 4294967296 on its terminal update, still an exact safe integer. Loop counters, cut sizes and all lengths are exact. No bitwise truncation or numeric sentinel values occur.
complexity: O(n*log(n + 1) + 1) worst-case time and O(1) auxiliary space, including one sentinel. Each bottom-up pass splits disjoint runs and stably merges adjacent runs; the walk to each merged tail remains linear in the combined run lengths. The run width doubles until it covers n. There is no recursion, per-node metadata table or node-array copy.

helpers.name: Link
helpers.contract: A fully included sentinel class with only a next field initialized from next_node. A fresh instance precedes the input list during one call; it is not an output ListNode and is never returned. No input value is stored or changed.
helpers.cost: The full helper definition is 82 UTF-8 bytes including indentation and terminal newline, already included in source bytes. One constant-size instance per call, O(1) constructor time and live space; its complete definition and all call sites are charged.

helpers.name: split_run
helpers.contract: Detach at most size nodes from a run and return the first remainder node, or None. For a nonempty run, the last included node next is set to None. size is a positive integer; empty input is a no-op.
helpers.cost: The full helper definition is 243 UTF-8 bytes including indentation and terminal newline, already included in source bytes. O(min(size, run length) + 1) time and O(1) space. All cut scans and edge writes are charged per merge pass.

helpers.name: merge_after
helpers.contract: Given two disjoint sorted runs and a preceding tail outside both, relink the stable merge after tail, choosing the left run on equal values; attach the remaining suffix and return its final tail. Runs must be None-terminated; no node or sentinel is allocated.
helpers.cost: The full helper definition is 404 UTF-8 bytes including indentation and terminal newline, already included in source bytes. O(left length + right length + 1) time, including the final tail scan, and O(1) space. Caller supplies the single outer sentinel or an already merged original-node tail; no hidden helper allocation.
